title: DOW-UAP-PR116, Unresolved UAP Report, Atlantic Ocean, 2020
what_is_it: A U.S. military video record: 32 seconds of infrared sensor footage of an unresolved unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP), submitted for analysis with an accompanying debrief.
interpretation_warnings: The case is classified as 'unresolved'; no official conclusion is stated as to what the object was.
The object's described behaviour (travelling with the wind, not manoeuvring, balloon-like appearance) is consistent with a balloon, but the document does not confirm an identification.
No source text could be extracted from the PDF; the object descriptions rely on the war.gov CSV metadata and video description, not on a directly readable primary document.
Physical descriptions (colour, 12-15 feet height) come from a single observer debrief and were not independently verified.
The war.gov video description explicitly states it is informational only and should not be read as an analytical judgment or factual determination about the event's validity.

key_facts.source_quote: an infrared sensor aboard a U.S. military platform in 2020
